templates.html:
<button type="button" class="btn-close btn-close--{{size}}" style="--bg:{{bg}};border-radius:{{radius}}px" aria-label="{{label}}"{{#if disabled}} disabled{{/if}}>
  <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/></svg>
</button>
<style>
.btn-close {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: #241430;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 8px;
}
.btn-close--sm { padding: 5px; }
.btn-close--lg { padding: 11px; }
.btn-close:hover:not(:disabled) { background: rgba(36,20,48,.1); color: var(--bg); }
.btn-close:active:not(:disabled) { background: rgba(36,20,48,.18); }
.btn-close:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #241430;outline-offset:2px; }
.btn-close:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: not-allowed; }
</style>
templates.tailwind:
<button type="button" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center border-none bg-transparent cursor-pointer text-[#241430] disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed hover:bg-black/10 active:bg-black/15 btn-close-tw btn-close-tw--{{size}}" style="border-radius:{{radius}}px" aria-label="{{label}}"{{#if disabled}} disabled{{/if}}>
  <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/></svg>
</button>
<style>
.btn-close-tw--sm { padding: 5px; }
.btn-close-tw--md { padding: 8px; }
.btn-close-tw--lg { padding: 11px; }
.btn-close-tw:hover:not(:disabled) { color: {{bg}}; }
.btn-close-tw:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #241430;outline-offset:2px; }
</style>
